comment: Three outputs are declared with no port widget, LOW_INV, MID_INV and HIGH_INV at indices 7, 9 and 11 (Triton.cpp:130), so no click can reach them and they are left untagged. The centre knob reads in hertz on its tooltip through a custom quantity, C4 times two to the power of the knob value (Triton.cpp:72). The spread runs from half an octave to three octaves either side of the centre and the gap tilts each crossover's two corners up to two octaves apart (Triton.cpp:364).
